Customs

Profilage de Risque

A systematic customs compliance process analyzing shipment, trader, or transaction data to assess the likelihood of regulatory violations, security threats, or fraud.

Quick answer: A systematic customs compliance process analyzing shipment, trader, or transaction data to assess the likelihood of regulatory violations, security threats, or fraud.

Quick answer

A systematic customs compliance process analyzing shipment, trader, or transaction data to assess the likelihood of regulatory violations, security threats, or fraud.

Why it matters

Profilage de Risque matters because it supports clear communication in Customs contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Profilage de Risque?

In this glossary, Profilage de Risque refers to: A systematic customs compliance process analyzing shipment, trader, or transaction data to assess the likelihood of regulatory violations, security threats, or fraud.

How is Profilage de Risque used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Le profilage de risque douanier a sélectionné le conteneur pour inspection sur la base des infractions précédentes du commerçant."

Why does Profilage de Risque matter in logistics?

Profilage de Risque matters because it supports clear communication in Customs contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Profilage de Risque?

Profilage de Risque is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Profilage de Risque belong to?

In this glossary, Profilage de Risque is grouped under Customs. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A systematic customs compliance process analyzing shipment, trader, or transaction data to assess the likelihood of regulatory violations, security threats, or fraud.

Operational example

Customs risk profiling flagged the container for inspection based on the trader’s previous infraction record.

Localized term

Profilage de Risque

Localized example

Le profilage de risque douanier a sélectionné le conteneur pour inspection sur la base des infractions précédentes du commerçant.
